# SFEXIS — Strong Field Electron XUV Interaction Simulator

> Federico Vismarra's MATLAB code for attosecond XUV/IR photoemission in the
> strong-field approximation. Original full-script examples are the primary
> workflow; a separate AI companion supports function-based automation.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/fedefirefox/SFEXIS

Current release: [v1.0.0](https://github.com/fedefirefox/SFEXIS/releases/tag/v1.0.0).
This major version recognizes the established code and its author's extensive
prior testing; the repository also records automated reproducibility checks.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/fedefirefox/SFEXIS/blob/main/README.md): setup and examples.
- [Physics and original implementation](https://github.com/fedefirefox/SFEXIS/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md): equations, units, settings and documented small changes.
- [AI companion](https://github.com/fedefirefox/SFEXIS/blob/main/ai_companion/README.md): separate implementation with different fields and quadrature.
- [Environment](https://github.com/fedefirefox/SFEXIS/blob/main/ENVIRONMENT.md): MATLAB and toolbox requirements.
- [Validation](https://github.com/fedefirefox/SFEXIS/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md): actual tests and untested branches.
- [Releases](https://github.com/fedefirefox/SFEXIS/releases): tagged snapshots and release notes.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/fedefirefox/SFEXIS/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): changes and historical milestones.

## Attribution and rights

- [Citation](https://github.com/fedefirefox/SFEXIS/blob/main/CITATION.md): Federico Vismarra's code credit and full six-author 2022 article reference, doi:10.1088/2515-7647/ac7991.
- [CITATION.cff](https://github.com/fedefirefox/SFEXIS/blob/main/CITATION.cff): machine-readable preferred citation.
- [CodeMeta](https://github.com/fedefirefox/SFEXIS/blob/main/codemeta.json): software discovery metadata.
- [Licensing scope](https://github.com/fedefirefox/SFEXIS/blob/main/LICENSING.md): BSD-3-Clause for identified project files; mixed-license bundle and unresolved permissions.
- [Third-party notices](https://github.com/fedefirefox/SFEXIS/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): independently credited helper sources and terms.
- [Provenance](https://github.com/fedefirefox/SFEXIS/blob/main/docs/PROVENANCE.md): preserved original sources and history.

The included code is a single-point forward simulation. Full ensemble averaging,
ePIE and inverse pulse/photoemission-delay retrieval are not included. The paper
DOI is not a software DOI. This file is an optional plain-text documentation
index; it does not guarantee indexing, AI training inclusion or citation.
